description: This file implements a job scheduling mechanism for one-time jobs within the Mattermost server, including job creation, execution, cancellation, and metadata management using a key-value store.

classes.name: JobOnce
classes.description: Represents a scheduled one-time job with methods for execution, cancellation, and metadata management.

classes.name: JobOnceMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata for a JobOnce, including key, scheduled run time, and properties.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Terminates the scheduled job and removes it from the store.

methods.name: newJobOnce
methods.description: Creates a new JobOnce instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the job at the scheduled time, with retries on failure.

methods.name: executeJob
methods.description: Invokes the callback associated with the job.

methods.name: readMetadata
methods.description: Reads job metadata from the key-value store.

methods.name: saveMetadata
methods.description: Saves job metadata to the key-value store.

methods.name: cancelWhileHoldingMutex
methods.description: Cancels the job while holding its mutex, cleaning up resources.
